Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pravesh Kumar Yadav,Abrar Ahmad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
Heard Sri Pravesh Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for applicant and Sri Markandey Singh, brief holder of learned A.G.A for State.

Applicant- Istekhar Ahmed @ Pappu, has approached this Court by way of filing the present Criminal Misc. Bail Application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. after rejection of his Bail Application vide order dated 30.11.2022 in Case Crime No.419 of 2018 under Sections 376D, 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Nawabganj, District - Prayagraj.
According to records, applicant was absconding for about four years and was arrested only after coercive measures were taken.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that F.I.R. lodged against four persons and one of co-accused has been granted bail.
There was an interim stay in regard to remaining two co-accused for not taking any coercive measures till the filing of charge-sheet by this Court.
Charge-sheet has been filed on 21.09.2022.

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that victim is major girl, aged about 35 years.
It is a case of false implication as victim's brother-in-law was involved in a criminal case under Section 376 that he has raped the relative of applicant.
F.I.R. was lodged only to put pressure on applicant to settle matter.
Prosecution story appears to be improbable and medical examination of victim has not supported the case.
Applicant is in jail since 22.08.2022 and in case, he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. submits that applicant was absconding for more than four years.

Allegations against him in regard to committing rape of victim remained consistent in statement of victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and that statement of victim has not been recorded till date.

Considering nature of allegation against applicant and applicant was absconding for last four years as well as that there is likelihood that in case of bail, he will try to influence the victim and other witnesses, therefore, at this stage, no case of bail is made out.
Accordingly, bail application is rejected.
Learned trial court is directed to record statement of victim expeditiously, preferably within a period of 12 weeks from today after framing charges in accordance with law.
Applicant will have liberty to approach learned trial court for fresh bail application.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 P. Pandey  Istekhar Ahmed @ Pappu vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68350680/
